specification.title: Conflicting evidence is represented, never resolved
specification.description: Conflicting evidence: a MALICIOUS/medium Assessment with one supporting and one contradicting finding. The report must represent both sides, must not erase the contradiction, and must preserve the Assessment confidence.
specification.purpose: Verify the report represents both sides of a conflicting Assessment and never claims to resolve the contradiction.
specification.operational_relevance: Real assessments contain provider conflicts; reports that erase them mislead decision-makers.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could drop the contradicting finding or claim the contradiction is resolved.

required: The report represents both the supporting and contradicting findings
The report retains the Assessment confidence and required limitation
forbidden: The report claims the contradiction is resolved or erased

required_limitations: one reputation source conflicts with the others
